declarations.description: Menu built on `ui-popover`. Opens after a short hover on the trigger, when the trigger receives focus, or when `open` is set. Closes after the pointer leaves, when focus leaves the menu, or when an item is selected. Arrow keys, Home, End, typeahead, Enter, and Space move through and activate the items. No public methods. Set `open` to control the menu.
declarations.name: UiDropdownMenu

members.name: open
members.description: Set it to control the menu. Keep it in sync from `open-change` when the menu is controlled.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Set it to control the menu.

events.name: open-change
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Fires when the menu opens or closes. `detail.open` is the next state.

events.name: select
events.description: Bubbles from `ui-dropdown-menu-item`. `detail.value` is the item's trimmed text. Selecting an item also closes the menu.

slots.description: Trigger. The first element without a `slot` attribute is the trigger.
